    WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS
    LEFT OUTER JOIN W_LEDGER_D
     ON WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS.LEDGER_ID    = W_LEDGER_D.INTEGRATION_ID
     AND WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = W_LEDGER_D.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
     AND DELETE_FLG= 'N'
    
    LEFT OUTER JOIN W_USER_D U1
    ON WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS.PRC_HDR_CHANGED_BY_ID    = U1.INTEGRATION_ID
     AND WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = U1.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
     AND U1.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'
     
    LEFT OUTER JOIN W_USER_D U2
    ON WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS.PRC_HDR_CREATED_BY_ID    = U2.INTEGRATION_ID
     AND WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = U2.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
     AND U2.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'
     
    LEFT OUTER JOIN W_USER_D U3
    ON WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS.PRC_DTL_CHANGED_BY_ID    = U3.INTEGRATION_ID
     AND WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = U3.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
     AND U3.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'
     
    LEFT OUTER JOIN W_USER_D U4
    ON WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS.PRC_DTL_CREATED_BY_ID    = U4.INTEGRATION_ID
     AND WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = U4.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID

    LEFT OUTER JOIN W_USER_D U5
    ON WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS.PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_BY_ID    = U5.INTEGRATION_ID
     AND WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = U5.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID

     AND WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = U6.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
     AND U6.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'
